# WSP Office Capital Towers

> This office suite at Capital Towers is the United Arab Emirates workplace of an international engineering and professional-services consultancy. It provides open-plan desking, meeting rooms, collaboration areas and support space for technical and administrative staff. Capital Towers is a commercial tower development offering leased office accommodation to corporate tenants in the emirates.' If the client instead wants the tenant brand kept as public identity, clear the Consultant field so the two do not contradict.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2017

## MENASCO Scope

This office was delivered for WSP, the international engineering consultancy, at Capital Towers. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the office for Gulf Commercial Group, with WSP itself acting as consultant on the scheme. The project reflects MENASCO's experience in delivering building services for corporate office interiors for leading professional firms in the UAE.
